oracle: Events and all query expected keys/status/values/source IDs are manually authored; no product extractor/resolver/provider/search or remote model used as gold. Event/time normalization and build_documents are used solely for input validation and embedding input hashes.
controlled_scope: Retrieval backend comparison only: same fact-key documents, project and known_at prefilter, shared V1 resolver; Mem0 infer=False; not a reproduction of native Mem0 extraction/correction.
recorded_vector_kind: Artificial ideal-ranking test double, not a real embedding capture; cannot establish semantic quality or cost improvement.
split_policy: Dev queries only AsterDocs/ParcelNest; holdout queries only CedarTrack plus an unrecorded scope. All rule families and field vocabulary may be shared; no claim of template independence.
timeline_policy: Load all events before queries; as_of is effective time. known_at is observation cutoff applied before document construction. Default current knowledge may use later observations to reconstruct earlier effective facts.
scope_policy: Project and worker facts with same predicate are distinct keys. Query source sets must remain in query project/key. Unknown with expected_key means key is known but no effective fact; null expected_key means no relevant recorded key.
holdout_policy: Freeze first, tune only on dev, run holdout for first release verification after parameters fixed; preserve first result, no gold edits to fit product output.
vector_basis: Full (subject,predicate) one-hot identity; independent unknown basis. Subject distractor facts remain in unchanged gold.
